components.label: CyberCraft's Minecraft: portable Prism Launcher (GPL-3.0), Fabric API, e4mc
Codeware by psiberx (MIT): lights, colliders, third person, weather
Mod Settings by jackhumbert (MIT): CyberCraft's options in the pause menu

notes.firstLaunch: The first time, Melty signs CyberCraft's Minecraft in with the Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition before the game starts. While Cyberpunk loads, Prism downloads Minecraft and Java in the background (a few minutes, once). Minecraft then runs hidden and takes over V once a save has loaded. Your world opens to friends by itself; turn off Open to friends in Mod Settings to keep it private.
notes.beforeInstall: CyberCraft runs on Cyberpunk 2077 patch 2.31. Patch 2.5 isn't supported yet: RED4ext, Codeware and ArchiveXL, which CyberCraft is built on, haven't been updated for it, and every RED4ext mod crashes on 2.5 until they are. If you have CyberCraft: Portable Prism or CyberCraft: Friends installed, remove it first: they're older remixes of this mashup and put the same files in the game.
